statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the maximum of the set { (nums[i]-1)*(nums[j]-1) | 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), i != j }. Equivalently, r is the largest value of (nums[i]-1)*(nums[j]-1) over all choices of two different indices i and j.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 500, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if M = max { nums[i] | 0 <= i < len(nums) }, then r <= (M-1)*(M-1).
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 500, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i and j with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), and i != j, we have (nums[i]-1)*(nums[j]-1) <= r.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 500, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there exist indices i and j such that 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), i != j, and r = (nums[i]-1)*(nums[j]-1).
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 500, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, let M1 be the largest value among the entries of nums, and let M2 be the largest value among the entries of nums after removing one occurrence of M1 (so if M1 occurs at least twice, M2 = M1). Then r = (M1-1)*(M2-1).
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 500, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: For every slice nums' with 2 <= len(nums') <= 500, every entry of nums' in [1,1000], and the same multiset of entries as nums, the result returned on nums' equals the result returned on nums.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 500, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: For every slice nums' with len(nums') = len(nums), 1 <= nums'[i] <= 1000 for every i, and nums[i] <= nums'[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), the result returned on nums' is greater than or equal to the result returned on nums.
